asset.source:
{# NAME: 11-闭口-非圆头键槽-粗铣(深度1刀/宽度2刀/刀具半径=圆角半径) #}
;----粗铣键槽子程序----
GX73
GZ73 Y0
L184(0,0,,,,0)
L171("{{ U_RT }}")
L172(0)
L171("{{ U_RTB }}")
GX73
GZ73 Y0
L184(0,90,,,,0)
L140(0.00,4,0)
SETMS(1)
DIAMOF
G17
G90
D1
;''''基础坐标系偏移''''
XMW_1=0 YMW_1=0 ZMW_1=I_R9[35]+I_R9{{ U_ID }} CMW_1=0
G59 X=XMW_1 Y=YMW_1 Z=ZMW_1 C=CMW_1
;''''旋转-定位键槽''''
AROT Y90
AROT Z180
ATRANS X{{ (U_Z) | v3_fixed(3) }} Z{{ (U_D/2) | v3_fixed(3) }}
;''''起转-给水''''
G97 S1={{ (U_RTRPM) | v3_fixed(0) }} M1=3
M13=8 M10=150 H50=80
;-----------
;''''刀具定位''''
G94 G40 G0 X{{ (U_Q-U_ALBR-U_RTD-(U_RC+2)/(U_ANG | tan_d)) | v3_fixed(3) }} Y0 C=DC(0.00)
G0 Z10
G1 Z2 F400
;''''{{ (U_ANG) | v3_fixed(0) }}°入刀''''
G1 X{{ (U_Q-U_ALBR-U_RTD) | v3_fixed(3) }} Z{{ (-U_RC) | v3_fixed(1) }} F200
;''''粗铣''''
G1 G41 X{{ (U_Q-U_ALBR) | v3_fixed(3) }} F{{ (U_RTRF) | v3_fixed(0) }}
G1 Y{{ (U_B/2-U_ALBR) | v3_fixed(3) }} F{{ (U_RTRF/2) | v3_fixed(0) }}
G1 X{{ (-(U_A-U_Q)) | v3_fixed(3) }} F{{ (U_RTRF) | v3_fixed(0) }}
G1 X{{ (-(U_A+U_Q-U_ALBR)) | v3_fixed(3) }} F{{ (U_RTRF/2) | v3_fixed(0) }}
G1 Y{{ (-(U_B/2-U_ALBR)) | v3_fixed(3) }}
G1 X{{ (-U_Q) | v3_fixed(3) }} F{{ (U_RTRF) | v3_fixed(0) }}
G1 X{{ (U_Q-U_ALBR) | v3_fixed(3) }} F{{ (U_RTRF/2) | v3_fixed(0) }}
G1 Y{{ (U_B/2-U_ALBR) | v3_fixed(3) }}
;''''半精铣''''
G1 Z{{ (-U_C) | v3_fixed(3) }} F60
G1 Y{{ (U_B/2-U_ALBHF) | v3_fixed(3) }} F{{ (U_RTFF/2) | v3_fixed(0) }}
G1 X{{ (-(U_A-U_Q)) | v3_fixed(3) }} F{{ (U_RTFF) | v3_fixed(0) }}
G1 X{{ (-(U_A+U_Q-U_ALBHF)) | v3_fixed(3) }} F{{ (U_RTFF/2) | v3_fixed(0) }}
G1 Y{{ (-(U_B/2-U_ALBHF)) | v3_fixed(3) }}
G1 X{{ (-U_Q) | v3_fixed(3) }} F{{ (U_RTFF) | v3_fixed(0) }}
G1 X{{ (U_Q-U_ALBHF) | v3_fixed(3) }} F{{ (U_RTFF/2) | v3_fixed(0) }}
G1 Y{{ (U_B/2-U_ALBHF) | v3_fixed(3) }}
G1 X{{ (-U_RTD/2) | v3_fixed(3) }}
G1 G40 Y0 Z2
G0 Z100
;-----------
ROT
TRANS
DIAMON
M14=9
M13=9
M10=151
M1=5
GX73
GZ73 Y0
M01
;-----------
M17

;........

asset.source:
{# 铣键槽公共头部 - 所有粗铣/精铣/倒角子程序共用 #}
{# 传入变量: tool_num(本次刀号), next_tool_num(下一把刀备刀,可为空), spindle_speed, coolant_m_code, is_left_open, U_Z, U_A, U_D, U_ID #}
GX73
GZ73 Y0
L184(0,0,,,,0)
L171("{{ tool_num }}")
L172(0)
{% if next_tool_num %}L171("{{ next_tool_num }}")
{% endif %}GX73
GZ73 Y0
L184(0,90,,,,0)
L140(0.00,4,0)
SETMS(1)
DIAMOF
G17
G90
{{ tool_offset }}
;''''基础坐标系偏移''''
XMW_1=0 YMW_1=0 ZMW_1=I_R9[35]+I_R9{{ U_ID }} CMW_1=0
G59 X=XMW_1 Y=YMW_1 Z=ZMW_1 C=CMW_1
;''''旋转-定位键槽''''
AROT Y90
AROT Z180
{% if is_left_open %}
ATRANS X{{ (U_Z - U_A) | v3_fixed(3) }} Z{{ (U_D / 2) | v3_fixed(3) }}
AROT Z180
{% else %}
ATRANS X{{ (U_Z) | v3_fixed(3) }} Z{{ (U_D / 2) | v3_fixed(3) }}
{% endif %}
;''''起转-给水''''
G97 S1={{ (spindle_speed) | v3_fixed(0) }} M1=3
M14=8 M10=150 H50=80
